name: Lettuce Chlorosis Virus (LCV)
hosts: More than 27 plant species in 12 botanical families
symptoms: Yellowing and reddening of leaves Curling of leaves Thinning of leaf veins Stunted or dwarf plants Reduced yield and flower quality
description: A viral disease affecting lettuce and other crops, causing yellowing, reddening, and curling of leaves, stunted growth, and reduced yield. Transmitted by whiteflies and contaminated plant material.
management: Remove and destroy infected plants Monitor and control whitefly populations Use virus-free seeds and cuttings Maintain good hygiene and sanitation of tools Remove weeds that act as reservoirs
prevention: Use certified virus-free planting material Isolate new plants from infected areas Control weed hosts in and around fields Regular monitoring for whiteflies
